score.note: only to freeze the elements of each role by id

da:Aviso_Dur.doc: Duration of the prototype notice (phase 16), if bDisclaimer.

da:Titulo_Aparece.doc: When the SOUL CHARGER title is placed in the Hall (PT of phase 9).

da:Logos_RevelaIni.doc: The logos start to reveal (JHU +0.3 s, IDEAS +0.6 s).

da:Titulo_SaleIni.doc: Title, subtitle and logos start to leave.

da:Titulo_SaleFin.doc: Title, subtitle and logos finish leaving.

da:Hall_VeloAbreIni.doc: The black veil starts to open onto the Hall mist.

da:Hall_VeloAbreFin.doc: The veil finishes opening in the Hall.

da:Hall_IntroA.doc: When the Obra tells the Hall to start (HallIntro).

da:HUD_EEGRetardo.doc: How long after the HUD is born the EEG line is born.

da:Etapa_VeloAbreIni.doc: The color veil starts to open the stage (T).

da:Etapa_VeloAbreFin.doc: The veil finishes opening the stage.

da:Etapa_TituloRevelaIni.doc: The stage title starts to reveal.

da:Etapa_TituloSaleIni.doc: The stage title starts to leave.

da:Etapa_TituloOculto.doc: From here the stage title stays hidden.

da:Alma_Entra.doc: When Alma enters (end of phase 0; the stage clock jumps to 9 at that moment).

da:Alma_VozRetardo.doc: How long Alma waits to start speaking on arrival.

da:Alma_TrasVoz.doc: How long Alma stays after speaking, before the instructions.

da:Instr_Dur.doc: Instruction time before StageBegin, per stage.

da:Instr_EsperaMax.doc: Attracting: maximum wait for the brief voices before starting.

da:Etapa_Tope.doc: After N s of mechanic the Obra asks the stage to close its own way (Attracting saves the melody, Surrounding presents the drawing).

da:Corte_Espera.doc: If the stage hasn't closed N s after the request, it closes anyway (safety cap).

da:Salida_Dur.doc: Stage exit (StageOutro) before the charge; never less than the voice + Salida_TrasVoz.

da:Salida_TrasVoz.doc: Margin after the congratulation voice before the charge.

da:Carga_Dur.doc: Duration of the ring charge per stage (the last is the final charge).

da:Carga_Minima.doc: Minimum of the charge phase before it can be closed.

da:Despedida_Retardo.doc: How long Alma waits to invite to the next stage.

da:Despedida_TrasVoz.doc: How long Alma stays after the invitation before leaving.

da:Velo_CierreDur.doc: How long the veil takes to close the stage before moving on to the next.

da:Sim_EtapaMax.doc: With bSimulated: Attracting and Surrounding are asked to close at N s (instead of Etapa_Tope).

da:Final_NegroRampa.doc: In the final charge, how long the ramp to black lasts (ends with the charge).

da:Regreso_HallA.doc: When, already in black, it jumps to the Hall for the return.

da:Regreso_VeloIni.doc: Return: the veil starts to open.

da:Regreso_PezA.doc: Return: when the user's soul leaves as a fish and the Hall follows it.

da:Res_AlmaA.doc: Results: when Alma arrives and starts the reading (VO_34b).

da:Res_PezMin.doc: Results: minimum before the user's soul settles in its ring.

da:Res_PezMax.doc: Results: the user's soul settles at N s at the latest.

da:Res_Explorar.doc: Results: time to explore after Alma's reading.

da:Res_InvitaRecorte.doc: The buttons appear N s before the invitation to share ends.

da:Res_BotonesVoz.doc: How long after the buttons appear Alma speaks (VO_36p).

da:Res_SalidaRetardo.doc: How long after choosing the panel goes away.

da:Res_Cortafuegos.doc: If nobody chooses SHARE/DON'T SHARE within N s, it chooses by itself.

da:Res_Tope.doc: Timeout for the whole results phase.

da:Comp_Nado.doc: SHARE: how long the user's soul swims to the door.

da:Comp_Lejos.doc: SHARE: how long the user's soul takes to leave through the door.

da:Salida_HallA.doc: When the exit from the Hall toward the constellation starts.

da:Const_AlmaLlega.doc: Constellation: when your soul appears (if you shared).

da:Const_Voz37TrasVoz.doc: Constellation: margin between VO_35b and VO_37.

da:Creditos_Dur.doc: Duration of the constellation with credits.

da:Fundido_Dur.doc: Final fade before restarting the piece.
